name: Knuth–Morris–Pratt prefix-function matching
definition: For pattern p of length m≥1, π_i=max({0}∪{k:1≤k≤i and p[0:k]=p[i−k+1:i+1]}). On mismatch at matched length q>0 set q←π_{q−1}; advance q on equality; when q=m emit a match and reset q←π_{m−1}.
variables: p pattern; π_i longest proper border length for prefix ending at i; q matched prefix length; slice end excluded

name: Suffix array prefix-doubling construction
definition: Start r_i as rank of symbol x_i. For span h=1,2,4,… sort indices by (r_i,r_{i+h}), using a smaller sentinel for i+h≥n; assign equal new ranks to equal pairs, then h←2h until ranks are unique or h≥n.
variables: n sequence length; i index; h prefix span; r_i prefix rank; sentinel for missing suffix
